description: Batch of up to 10 image URLs prepared for a vision LLM in one paid call: each auto-rotated, resized to max_side (default 1568 px), re-encoded JPEG/PNG/WebP (<= 2 MB base64 each), with data URI, size and sha256. Per-image errors listed; if no image works the call is not charged. Single image: GET /image-for-llm. Price: $0.05 USDC per call, paid with x402 on Base.

max_side.description: Longest side in px, 64-4096 (default 1568); never enlarged

urls.description: 1-10 public http(s) image URLs (JSON array, or a comma/newline-separated string)

name: webtools_images_for_llm
